opening.argument: The presentation walks through recognizable forms of online work: creating YouTube content, starting a blog, selling products through an e-commerce marketplace, and freelancing. Its account of YouTube includes subscriber and watch-time requirements, while the marketplace slide lays out a sequence from creating an account and listing products to a user purchase and revenue. The presenter also mentions affiliate marketing and tutoring. Broad earning figures appear alongside these topics, but the material primarily explains work methods and operational steps; it does not establish that any viewer will earn those amounts.

citations.quote: Number 5, YouTube. On the world's largest video platform. You can also create your own channel.
There is a requirement on YouTube that you have to have 1000 subscribers. And 4000 minute watch time.
